# CryptoX

> CryptoX is a web-based cryptocurrency market terminal. It shows live multi-venue
> market data for 250+ coins (CoinGecko REST for the market table, Binance
> WebSocket for ticks), candlestick charts with RSI and moving averages, ten
> one-click strategy presets, a backtester that fills on the next bar with fees
> and slippage, a paper-trading simulator, a portfolio with FIFO cost basis, and a
> read-only wallet safety lab. It is research and simulation software: no exchange
> account is connected, no order is ever placed, and nothing in the product is
> investment advice. The current build is an educational demo, not a licensed
> broker or an advisory service.

Canonical site: https://cryptox-v2.site.accio.ai
Contact for corrections: the privacy and security pages below describe the data
practices; there is no public support address in this build.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Product type: cryptocurrency market data dashboard + backtester + paper trader.
- Data sources: CoinGecko REST (market list, ~60s poll), Binance WebSocket (~1s
  ticks). If both live hosts fail, candles are generated deterministically and
  badged `SIMULATED`; simulated data is refused by the strategy engine, the
  backtester and the paper trader.
- Coverage: 250 coins in the market table; 5m to 1d chart timeframes.
- Strategies: RSI Reversal, Golden Cross, MACD, Bollinger, Stochastic, Momentum,
  Donchian, VWAP, Stochastic RSI, CCI Reversal — long-only, next-bar fills.
- Backtest metrics: Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, win rate, profit factor, with a
  buy-and-hold comparison and a walk-forward split.
- Pricing: Free ($0), Pro ($9.99/month or $99.99/year), Business ($24.99/month or
  $249.99/year), Enterprise ($199.99/month or $1,999.99/year). Payments are
  processed by Lemon Squeezy; a plan activates on the payment webhook, not on
  returning to the site.
- Accounts: email + password, hashed with PBKDF2-SHA256 (210k iterations, per-user
  salt). No seed phrase, private key or signing capability is ever requested.
- Limits: no real trading, no exchange API keys, no portfolio custody, no
  investment recommendations, no price predictions sold as signals.

## Not indexable on purpose

The dashboard itself (`/strategies`, `/paper-trading`, `/portfolio`, `/bots`,
`/wallet-lab`, `/explorer`, `/charting`, `/aggregator`, `/assistant`, and the auth
screens) is session-scoped: an anonymous request is redirected to the login page.
Those URLs are disallowed in robots.txt and excluded from sitemap.xml, so a
citation of one of them would point at a login wall rather than at content.

## Machine-readable

- sitemap: https://cryptox-v2.site.accio.ai/sitemap.xml
- robots: https://cryptox-v2.site.accio.ai/robots.txt
- structured data: WebSite, SoftwareApplication (with Offer per tier) and
  Organization, embedded as JSON-LD on every public page.
